READ ME
widgets_values:
# Qwen Comic workflow - how to use

**What you need to fill in (inputs)**
1. **Group 2 - STYLE REFERENCE**: load one image whose drawing style you want.
2. **Group 2 - Comic Page Layout**: pick a page template (`dynamic:` ones are slanted and more lively).
3. **Group 0 - CAST**: one character per line: `Mia: girl, red hair, yellow raincoat`.
   A different look in some panels: `Bolt [no bulb]: robot, bare antenna. without: red bulb`.
4. **Group 0 - SCRIPT** (*Comic Script Select*, `my_script`):
```
Panel 1: what we see in the panel
Caption: narration box text
Mia: speech bubble text
Mia (thought): thought bubble
Bolt (shout): SHOUTED TEXT!
SFX: BOOM
Panel 2 (low angle): Bolt [no bulb] looks up.
```
5. Click **Run**. The page is saved in `output/comic/`.

**What you get (outputs)**: Group 4 shows the finished page, the raw panels, the **Balloon list** and the **Vision check report** (group 3).

**Story mode**: write a story in *Comic Story Writer*, set `source` = **AI script from story**, turn **review_first** ON and run: only the script is written. Happy? Turn review_first OFF and run.

**Automatic quality control** (group 3, *Panel sampler*): every panel is checked by Qwen3.5. Duplicate characters, strangers or a forbidden item (e.g. the bulb) are removed with an edit pass, otherwise the panel is redrawn (`max_redraws`).

**Balloons**: placed automatically in empty space near the speaker. Move one by hand in *Comic Auto Letter* `adjust`: `4.1: x=0.25 y=0.14` (numbers are in the Balloon list). Only the lettering is redone.

**Toggles**: `whole_page` (one image for the page), `lettering` (crisp / AI-drawn / both / none), `use_control_canvas` (group 5), `camera` and `staging` in the Director. **Fast mode** (group 1): 4 steps. Off = 40 steps, ~10x slower.

nodes.title: Advanced: how to
widgets_values:
# Advanced control

Everything here draws on a page-sized **control canvas**:
- *Comic Place Image*: paste a reference (character, object, pose, background) at `panel`, `x`, `y` (0-1 inside the panel), `width` (relative to panel). Chain several.
- *Comic Text / Bubble*: put text/bubbles at a position; the AI redraws it in style.
- `panel = 0` uses whole-page coordinates.
- You can also replace the canvas with **your own sketch** (Load Image → Director.control_canvas).

Per-panel mode: only panels with something placed use the canvas. Whole-page mode: the whole canvas is the layout.

Then set **use_control_canvas = ON** in the Director.

Character consistency: group 6 draws a character sheet from the CAST once (cached) and feeds it to every panel. Use your own sheet: connect a Load Image to Director.character_ref instead.

nodes.title: DOWNLOADS & INSTALL
widgets_values:
# Downloads & where to put them

**Custom nodes** -> `ComfyUI/custom_nodes/`
- **ComfyUI-QwenComic** (this pack): copy the folder in, restart.
- **ComfyUI-GGUF** (only for the GGUF workflow): [github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF](https://github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF) or install via ComfyUI-Manager.

**Models** (ComfyUI Desktop: `...\ComfyUI-Shared\models\...`)
| file | folder | size |
|---|---|---|
| [qwen-image-edit-2511-Q4_K_M.gguf](https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-GGUF/resolve/main/qwen-image-edit-2511-Q4_K_M.gguf) (8-16 GB VRAM) | `models/unet` | 13.2 GB |
| or [qwen_image_edit_2511_fp8mixed.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-Edit_ComfyUI/resolve/main/split_files/diffusion_models/qwen_image_edit_2511_fp8mixed.safetensors) (24 GB+ VRAM) | `models/diffusion_models` | 20.5 GB |
| [qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image_ComfyUI/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors) | `models/text_encoders` | 9.4 GB |
| [qwen_image_vae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image_ComfyUI/resolve/main/split_files/vae/qwen_image_vae.safetensors) | `models/vae` | 0.3 GB |
| [Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-Lightning-4steps-V1.0-bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-Lightning/resolve/main/Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-Lightning-4steps-V1.0-bf16.safetensors) | `models/loras` | 0.8 GB |
| [qwen3.5_2b_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen3.5/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3.5_2b_bf16.safetensors) (vision check, story) | `models/text_encoders` | 4.5 GB |
| optional [qwen3.5_4b_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen3.5/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3.5_4b_bf16.safetensors) (better, slower) | `models/text_encoders` | 9.3 GB |

`text_encoders` = `clip` and `diffusion_models` = `unet` (old folder names work too). Press **R** in ComfyUI to refresh the model lists after downloading.

Needs ComfyUI **0.36 or newer** (tested on 0.37.2). Full guide with screenshots: **00_START_HERE_Guide.pdf** in the handover package, or README.md in the pack.

groups.title: 2 · INPUT: STYLE REFERENCE image + PAGE LAYOUT  (+ Director settings)
3 · Generate panels + automatic check & fix (duplicates, strangers, items)
4 · Assemble page + lettering  (OUTPUT: finished page, balloon list, move balloons with adjust)
5 · ADVANCED control canvas: place references & text at exact positions  →  turn ON 'use_control_canvas' in the Director
0 · INPUT: CAST (who is in the comic) + SCRIPT (what happens)  -  or let the local LLM write the script from a story
6 · CHARACTER SHEET: drawn once from the CAST, then used in every panel so characters stay identical
